plan.title: Dutch auction rejects zero end price

steps.note: Allow vendor addition during event creation.
Create the RFQ required for Dutch auction conversion.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Complete the remaining buyer pricing-sheet fields.
Confirm the location selection was retained.
Invite two available QA vendors to serve as Vendor A and Vendor B.
Commit the source RFQ's bidding schedule.
Open the converted auction create screen where Dutch strategy is available.
Select Dutch auction and exercise the explicitly permitted zero-value negative test.
Commit the converted auction's schedule before the requested publish attempt.
Require publication to be refused specifically for the invalid Dutch end price.
